request.initial_prompt: Aufidius. My rage is gone, And I am struck with sorrow.—Take him up. Help, three o' th' chiefest soldiers; I'll be one.— Beat thou the drum that it speak mournfully.— Trail your steel pikes. Though in this city he Hath widowed and unchilded many a one, Which to this hour bewail the injury, Yet he shall have a noble memory. Assist.
